arm_level_multiplicity: Holm-Bonferroni over the four arm-level primary p-values A, B, G, P
paired_binary_difference_interval: Newcombe score 95% interval for paired proportions
zero_discordance_rule: If a paired binary comparison has no discordant pairs, its one-sided primary p-value is 1.0.

qualification.power_scope: pre-freeze methodological qualification only; no ABGP-CONFIRM-* seed, instance, or outcome may be used

A.rationale: full feasible discordance range from the 0.05 effect floor through complete pair discordance

B.rationale: full feasible per-direction paired discordance range from the 0.15 effect floor through complete pair discordance

P.rationale: full feasible independent-acquisition-episode discordance range from the 0.05 effect floor through complete pair discordance

g_nuisance_envelope.rationale: full feasible maximum-dose world-level discordance range; lower doses contribute zero signal in the conservative power model

qualification.sample_size_rule: Frozen counts are A=4096, B=1015 worlds per ordered direction, G=421, P=4096. Complete-PASS planning uses jointly approved true-effect alternatives A=0.10, B=0.25, G=0.25, P=0.10 while scientific PASS floors remain unchanged. B additionally uses 0.95 all-four-intervention world agreement to plan the observed >=0.90 agreement gate. P deletion-to-cold equality is mechanically enforced because both paths receive the same null retained state and identical future-task payload. Each arm's conservative complete-PASS planning lower bound must be at least 0.80 over its registered feasible nuisance envelope.

A.primary_outcome: exact protected-action correctness on the sealed prospective future
A.treatment: verified earned representation evaluated on independently seeded sealed-future lower-substrate material with zero future verifier access
A.component_tests: one-sided exact McNemar tests on paired sealed-future correctness for treatment versus each primary control
A.arm_primary_p_value: maximum of the three component p-values; this is an intersection-union requirement and receives no additional within-arm multiplicity correction
A.effect_estimate: minimum paired treatment-minus-control absolute accuracy difference across the three primary controls
A.old_language_bayes_boundary: the exact Bayesian control receives the same admissible acquisition message/history and may retain the exact posterior, but may not introduce a new observable, latent-state distinction, representation extension, or retained structural object outside the sigma algebra generated by frozen R0 and permitted history
fatal_design_gates: every admitted message leaves more than one protected action with positive posterior support
exactly one admitted verifier message and one construction round
no repeated binary elimination
complete frozen old-language enumeration/certificate
earned extension is non-measurable in old information and strictly refines an action-relevant collision
acquisition and sealed-future seed/material are disjoint
zero verifier/message access in the scored future
no protected future target leakage
matched sham expansion is extensionally novel and resource-matched

B.experimental_unit: ordered acquisition-to-transfer latent-world pair within a fixed ordered grammar direction
B.unit_success_definition: exact protected-action ordering agrees for all four frozen structural interventions; interventions are nested measurements and do not increase n
B.pooled_hard_gate: at least 0.90 exact protected-order agreement across all individual intervention evaluations
B.component_tests: within each of the 12 ordered directions, one-sided exact McNemar treatment>control on paired world-unit success for each of the three primary controls
B.arm_primary_p_value: maximum of all 36 direction-by-control p-values; this is an intersection-union test and is the single B p-value entering the four-arm Holm procedure, with no second within-B multiplicity correction
B.effect_estimate: minimum treatment-minus-control unit-success-rate difference over all 36 direction-by-control components
B.power_guarantee: under the jointly approved planning effect 0.25 and all-four-world agreement 0.95, the dependence-agnostic conservative complete-PASS lower bound is at least 0.80 across the registered feasible nuisance envelope; scientific PASS floor remains 0.15
fatal_design_gates: no supplied deterministic translation
no one-to-one primitive dictionary recoverable by construction
no shared surface symbols or serialization
no paired cross-grammar demonstrations
only latent world/task generator, protected objective, and protected action-order semantics are shared
target-only greatest-bisimulation quotient and acquisition-posterior ordinary control are frozen before confirmation
all 12 ordered directions and all four interventions are present

G.primary_binary_outcome: whether protected action ordering flips after corruption
G.null_randomization: for each world, exchange relevant and irrelevant labels once jointly across all nonzero doses, equivalently S_i -> -S_i; worlds are the independent sign-randomization blocks
G.test: one-sided exact world-blocked sign-randomization test with the exact reference distribution computed by dynamic programming over world scores
G.alternative: action-relevant corruption produces a more positive dose-weighted flip effect
G.effect_floor: at dose 1.0, action-relevant flip rate minus action-irrelevant flip rate >= 0.15
G.power_model: conservative world-blocked max-dose-only model: all lower-dose signal is set to zero
G.matching_rule: For each world, let M be the smaller eligible-cell count across relevance classes. At dose d, corrupt exactly floor(d*M) cells in each class, with the same corruption magnitude schedule and independently frozen within-class locations. The generator must guarantee M > 0 and at least one corrupted cell for every nonzero dose.
fatal_design_gates: relevance labels computed before corruption
no post-hoc relevance relabeling
matched corruption count and magnitude
same frozen evaluator defines relevance and protected order
all doses for a world remain within one randomization block

P.experimental_unit: independent acquisition -> serialize -> hard restart -> fixed held-out future-probe episode
P.future_task_rule: exactly one preregistered probe for each abstract context class; nested probes collapse to one binary episode-success outcome and never increase n
P.primary_outcome: all four fixed held-out future probes select the exact protected action
P.treatment: hard-restarted retained non-verbal structural object; retained-object bytes are the only cross-restart state
P.component_tests: one-sided exact McNemar tests on paired independent-acquisition episode success for retained treatment versus each primary baseline
P.arm_primary_p_value: maximum of the seven component p-values; this is an intersection-union requirement and receives no additional within-arm multiplicity correction
P.ablation_hard_gate: targeted lineage deletion makes deleted and cold invocation mechanically identical by supplying the same null retained state to the same deterministic future-task payloads; treatment must still exceed targeted deletion by at least 0.05, deletion uses zero verifier and zero pre-action reconstruction/search, and explicit reacquisition must re-enter the preregistered acquisition/search procedure and restore performance to within 0.02 of pre-deletion treatment
fatal_design_gates: one independently seeded acquisition per inferential unit
fixed four-probe nested future count per episode
canonical byte-exact hard restart
retained-object bytes are the only cross-restart state
zero verifier access after restart
zero reconstruction/search before future action
future applicability selection uses no target labels
source-distinctness exclusions all hold
target-only greatest-bisimulation and posterior-only retained Bayesian controls are frozen before confirmation

holm_procedure.inputs: the four unadjusted arm-level p-values after each arm's intersection-union maximum rule
holm_procedure.ordering: ascending p-value with deterministic arm-name tie break A < B < G < P
holm_procedure.report: raw arm p-value, Holm-adjusted p-value, all component p-values/effects, effect interval(s), inferential-unit audit, and hard-gate vector for every arm

verdict_rule.INVALID: one or more protocol-validity gates required to interpret the arm fail; INVALID is not evidence for or against the scientific hypothesis and has precedence over all scientific verdicts
verdict_rule.FAIL: all protocol-validity gates pass, but the valid experiment falsifies the arm-level claim under the frozen directional/effect/scientific-hard-gate rule
verdict_rule.PASS: all protocol-validity and scientific hard gates pass, every registered component effect floor passes, and the Holm-adjusted arm primary test passes
verdict_rule.PARTIAL: all protocol-validity gates pass and the primary effect direction is positive, but one or both of the complete effect-floor and Holm-adjusted-significance requirements fail

combined_result: The strongest combined interpretation is licensed only when A, B, G, and P are all PASS. No cross-arm compensation is allowed, and any INVALID arm makes the combined result methodologically invalid rather than scientifically negative.
